subject: Eval pilot packaging and staggered invoicing for ProbeAI
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@probeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@probeai.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short pilot + staggered invoice option?

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ProbeAI is excited to try Redwood on our ingestion / QA workloads. We are targeting a 6-week technical pilot but our finance team prefers a staggered invoice schedule rather than one upfront charge.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm a time-boxed 6-week scope and a sample pricing breakdown?
- Would Redwood accept a 30/40/30 invoice split (instead of 50% upfront) tied to a mid-pilot milestone?

I attached the pilot scope for context (ProbeAI_Scope.pdf). Procurement is looped for visibility.

Best,
Samir
Director of ML Engineering
ProbeAI

---
Attachment: ProbeAI_Scope.pdf (application/pdf, 78 KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@probeai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot + staggered invoice option?

Samir —

Appreciate the scope doc. We can absolutely do a 6-week time-boxed pilot. High level proposal:

- Duration: 6 weeks (technical evaluation + handoff)
- List price: $60k (covers reserved capacity, support, and onboarding engineering time)
- Proposed invoice schedule (standard): 50% upfront / 25% at week 3 / 25% on completion

Given your ask for a 30/40/30 split, I can raise this with finance/ops but will need an approval for: a) accepting a smaller upfront payment (risk to seat allocation) and b) a small concession on list price to keep the economics neutral.

I attached a quick pricing grid with alternative splits and the unit math so you can share with procurement (pilot-pricing-grid.xlsx).

If it helps, we can also offer a 10% engagement discount for a commitment to a follow-on dedicated pilot within 90 days.

Next steps: if the 30/40/30 is a hard constraint, confirm and I’ll request internal approval (cc'ing Laura). Otherwise, tell me if you prefer the 50/25/25 and I’ll send the addendum.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

---
Attachment: pilot-pricing-grid.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx, 14 KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@probeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@probeai.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short pilot + staggered invoice option?

Jordan —

Thanks for the options. Procurement is comfortable with a milestone mid-point payment; 30/40/30 helps our cash flow given other vendor commitments.

Counter-proposal on price: 12% discount off the $60k list given the staggered schedule. We’d also like the mid-pilot milestone to be acceptance of the KV-cache latency profile (docs in the scope).

If you can’t do 12%, please let me know what is feasible so we can move quickly — the engineering team is ready to start the week of Apr 5.

—Samir
Procurement looped: procurement@probeai.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Short pilot + staggered invoice option? — approval request

Laura / Markus —

Quick recap: ProbeAI wants a 6-week time-boxed pilot. They prefer a 30/40/30 invoice split and are asking for a 12% discount on the $60k list price. Mid-pilot milestone tied to KV-cache latency acceptance. Engineering ready to start the week of Apr 5 if we approve.

Questions:
1) Is 12% off list something we can approve at AE level?
2) If not, is a 10% discount + change invoice schedule to 35/35/30 acceptable as a compromise? That would preserve cash flow and reduce our upfront exposure.

I've pasted Samir's email below for context.

Thanks —
Jordan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short pilot + staggered invoice option? — approval request

Jordan —

Thanks for the context. Approve a concession but keep it within guardrails: offer 10% discount (final price $54k) and move invoice schedule to 35% upfront / 35% at mid-pilot / 30% on completion.

Rationale: 10% is within our AE+manager approval band and the 35/35/30 split reduces our credit exposure while giving ProbeAI better cash flow. We should require the mid-pilot milestone to be a documented performance acceptance test (the KV-cache latency check) with clear pass/fail criteria.

Please document the milestone and route the MSA addendum to legal/finance for a quick sign-off.

—Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@probeai.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@probeai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Short pilot + staggered invoice option?

Samir —

Appreciate the patience. We can do the following final offer:

- 6-week time-boxed pilot, list price $60,000
- Concession: 10% discount — final fee $54,000
- Invoice schedule: 35% ($18,900) due on kick-off / 35% ($18,900) at mid-pilot acceptance / 30% ($16,200) on completion
- Mid-pilot milestone: KV-cache latency acceptance test (pass/fail criteria to be documented in the addendum)
- Conditional: commitment to consider a dedicated pilot within 90 days gives you priority capacity scheduling (not a contractual revenue commitment).

I’ve attached the MSA addendum and pricing grid. If that looks good, sign via DocuSign and we’ll kick off engineering prep for the Apr 5 start.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abc123-probeai-msa

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
